title: Bihar family performs teen's 'last rites' after she marries Dalit boyfriend

The family declared her dead to them after the court appearance.

title: Idaho man built one bed in garage; 14 years later, idea delivered 396,000 beds
content: What began as a single homemade bunk bed in 2012 has blossomed into a widespread volunteer movement, Sleep in Heavenly Peace. With over 400 chapters in the U.S. and Canada, this initiative has successfully built and distributed hundreds of thousands of beds for children in need. Through Bunks Across America, volunteers unite for larger projects, ensuring every child has a comfortable place to sleep.

title: Mark Zuckerberg’s wife Priscilla Chan’s $125 million school to shut after 10 years
content: After ten years in operation, Priscilla Chan's Primary School in East Palo Alto has shut down. Supported by the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, the school was designed to provide essential services for low-income families. However, despite substantial funding, student outcomes frequently lagged behind state benchmarks. As the initiative pivots towards scientific research, this closure illustrates the difficulties faced by philanthropic educational endeavors.

title: Washington couple spent $300,000 on home plans; state wants 44 acres surrendered
content: Tyler Chambers embarked on an ambitious journey to construct his dream home in Washington. Investing nearly $300,000 into regulatory requirements and necessary studies, he was soon met with neighbor complaints that triggered additional demands. These included extensive environmental assessments and a permanent conservation deed restriction on two-thirds of his land. Undeterred by the financial and emotional strain, Chambers remains resolute in his quest to build a home.

title: Rafael Nadal vs Maria Francisca Perello net worth: Who is richer in 2026?

Nadal’s fortune is still considerably larger, thanks to tennis prize money, endorsements, investments and businesses built during and after his playing career. Perello has taken a lower-profile professional route, including work related to the Rafa Nadal Foundation, while supporting the family’s broader business and philanthropic pursuits.

title: Simone Biles builds $3M Texas waterfront mansion after years of planning

The couple started designing the home in 2020 and finished it in November 2025. The reported $3 million property includes a private gym, pool, sports court, large kitchen, spa-style bathroom, laundry room and a dedicated space for their dogs.

title: 23-year-old Georgia mayor removed from office after misconduct allegations

The city council uncovered serious concerns surrounding his management of resources and city property. Facing claims of financial impropriety, Williams defended himself by pointing to insufficient training. Now, Stockbridge is preparing for a special election to choose a new mayor to bridge the leadership gap.

title: 20 dead, dozens missing after building damaged during Israel-Hamas war collapses in Gaza

The aftermath has led to fears that numerous individuals may still be trapped beneath the debris. Rescue teams are actively searching for survivors and recovering bodies, amid reports that the building had been weakened by earlier Israeli attacks.

title: Gold mine collapses in Sudan: At least 60 workers killed, many more feared trapped

This incident underscores the severe risks faced by artisanal miners, exacerbated by inadequate safety measures and emergency resources. Moreover, the gold mining sector in Sudan is entangled with ongoing conflicts, forcing individuals into perilous mining endeavors.

content: Klein and Rector acquired the estate from the family of Juan Trippe . he brought in renowned architect Thierry Despont for an extensive renovation . the sprawling oceanfront compound returned to the market in the month of June with a $165 million price tag .

title: 'No question of rollback': Govt defends UPI charges as Rahul targets PM Modi
content: the government has ruled out any rollback of the proposed 0.4 per cent Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) on unified payments interface (UPI) transactions over Rs 2,000 . the decision comes amid sharp criticism from Opposition parties, traders and sections of the digital payments ecosystem .

title: 'Meta has admitted mistake': Govt says firm has no immunity, must remove abuse content

title: Chhattisgarh Maoist attack: 10 convicts sentenced to death 13 years after massacre
content: NIA court on Wednesday sentenced all 10 convicts to death in the 2013 attack in Chhattisgarh . 29 people were killed and more than 30 others injured in the attack . the attack was one of the deadliest incidents of violence linked to Left Wing Extremism .
